newsitem.title: UK: Steady currency keeps pressure on UK grain prices.
newsitem.headline: Steady currency keeps pressure on UK grain prices.

text.p: A steady sterling and slow demand kept pressure on UK grain prices on Monday in moderate trading.

Lower U.S. grain futures during the afternoon added to the pressure and by the close wheat futures where 1.05 to 0.50 stg down after trading 512 lots while barley was 1.25 to 0.50 stg lower on a turnover of 100 lots.
The Amsterdam milling wheat futures started the week neglected.
UK cash business was also slow with feed wheat for Oct trading at 105.75 stg and for Dec at 105 stg fob ex-east coast ports.
Delivered market traders reported little activity in their sector.
"The market has started this week where it left off last week, very quiet," said a trader.
